plans.title: City of Sampaguita Comprehensive Land Use Plan 2023-2031

pages.heading: Land use and zoning
paragraphs: This Comprehensive Land Use Plan sets the land use policy of the City of Sampaguita for 2023 to 2031. It divides the city's 12 barangays into zones based on present land use, growth needs and natural hazards.
Flood susceptibility follows the city's hazard maps. Where susceptibility is high, the plan restricts uses that would place more households in the path of floodwater.
Table 1 lists the zone of each barangay, its flood susceptibility, the uses it allows and the uses it does not allow.

pages.heading: Land use and zoning (continued)
paragraphs: Protected zones keep the upland watershed and the coastal mangroves free of permanent structures. Agricultural zones keep farmland in production.

plans.title: City of Sampaguita Comprehensive Development Plan 2026-2031

pages.heading: Development goals
paragraphs: This Comprehensive Development Plan sets out the programs, projects and activities the City of Sampaguita intends to carry out from 2026 to 2031.
It follows the land use policy of the Comprehensive Land Use Plan and groups investments by sector: social, economic, infrastructure and environment.
The investment programme on the next page lists each project with its implementing office, location, estimated cost and schedule.

plans.title: City of Sampaguita Local DRRM Plan 2026-2028

pages.heading: Risk profile
paragraphs: This Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Plan covers 2026 to 2028. Flooding along the river is the city's main hazard, followed by riverbank erosion in the industrial barangays.
The plan funds prevention and mitigation, preparedness, response and rehabilitation measures. The measures on the next page are drawn from the hazard maps used in the Comprehensive Land Use Plan.

plans.title: City of Sampaguita Local Climate Change Action Plan 2026-2031 (Excerpt)

pages.heading: Climate change adaptation priorities
paragraphs: This excerpt of the Local Climate Change Action Plan lists adaptation measures for 2026 to 2031.
Heavier rainfall is expected to raise flood depths in the low-lying barangays. The measures on the next page reduce that exposure.
